hints.title: Character Deletion Mechanism
hints.text: Every star character consumes the nearest available non-star character to its immediate left.

hints.title: Last-In First-Out Processing
hints.text: Use a stack structure to collect characters. Push normal letters and pop the latest letter whenever an asterisk is encountered.

hints.title: String Reconstruction
hints.text: After iterating through all characters, join the remaining elements in the stack to form the output string.

hints.title: Stack Character Processing Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass with amortized O(1) push and pop operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated string slicing or deletions on immutable strings yields O(n^2) runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stack stores characters to build the resulting string in one join operation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies stack as the optimal structure for local backward removals.
